task_title: starlark-dsl guide matches shipped DSL: signatures, marshalling, json() encoder + drift guard
task_criteria: PROOF: go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/ passes at the integrated tip, and docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md contains the exact signatures http_get(url, headers=None) and json(value) plus a committed runnable example script demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star making the three documented calls. FAILIF: the drift test is absent from internal/builtin/, or it passes while the guide omits any builtin signature that dsl run --help prints, or the guide names a builtin the binary does not ship.

items.criterion: PROOF: go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/ passes at the integrated tip, and docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md contains the exact signatures http_get(url, headers=None) and json(value) plus a committed runnable example script demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star making the three documented calls. FAILIF: the drift test is absent from internal/builtin/, or it passes while the guide omits any builtin signature that dsl run --help prints, or the guide names a builtin the binary does not ship.
items.detail: (a) Drift test present: internal/builtin/dsl_docs_drift_test.go defines TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift; ran `go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/ -v` -> exit_code 0, output `--- PASS: TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift (0.00s)`. (b) Exact signatures in guide: grep docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md line 72-76 shows verbatim `http_get(url, headers=None) -> (status, body)` ... `json(value) -> string`; `go run ./cmd/openapi-cli dsl run --help` prints exactly those five signatures, so none omitted. (c) Anti-phantom clause: the test's dslPhantomNamesRe check passed against the live guide, and no http_*/json_* name in the guide is absent from the shipped binary. (d) Example script committed: demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star (new file in diff) makes exactly the three documented calls — http_post with dict body, json()-pre-encoded http_post, http_get with headers dict; I executed it end-to-end against the built binary and a live seeded Task Forge service and got `dict body -> status 201 / json() encoded body -> status 201 / headers dict -> status 200`, exit 0, matching the guide's documented Expected output block. (e) Negative control: the test also fails on its committed pre-fix fixture internal/builtin/testdata/starlark-dsl-prefix.md (asserted inside the test), and my own mutation (removing the headers=None param from the guide) made it FAIL with `guide is missing the shipped builtin signature \"http_get(url, headers=None) -> (status, body)\"` — the guard is not vacuous.

items.criterion: The committed example script actually runs against the shipped binary plus the documented demo-service prerequisites, producing the guide's documented output
items.detail: Built the CLI (go build ./cmd/openapi-cli), started demo/services/task-forge/server.py on :9801 and seeded with seed.py (project 1 created), then ran `/tmp/openapi-cli dsl run demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star`: output `dict body -> status 201`, `json() encoded body -> status 201`, `headers dict -> status 200`, script exit 0 — byte-identical to docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md Expected output (~line 308). Proves json() is shipped in the binary, dict-body marshalling works, and the script+guide run instructions are accurate.

items.criterion: The drift guard detects live drift in docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md, not only the committed fixture
items.detail: Mutation test: sed-replaced the http_get signature in the live guide and re-ran `go test -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/` -> `--- FAIL: TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ... guide is missing the shipped builtin signature \"http_get(url, headers=None) -> (status, body)\"`. Restored the guide (git status shows it unmodified afterwards) and the test passes again (`ok github.com/wojons/muster/internal/builtin 0.023s`).
